title: Charis sculpture-factory wildcat strike
location: Mya Sein Yaung Industrial Zone, Yangon Region; factory premises/front of compound
reason: Private-sector workplace dispute over bonus payment, firing/reinstatement and management conduct. The report describes no demand for domestic state policy. Police presence/threats are reported as response, not as a protest demand. Excluded under the codebook’s private wage-dispute restriction.
participants_reported: More than 300 of 500 workers; this size does not convert a private employer dispute into an eligible state-targeted protest.
